I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University (FSU). I study Comparative politics, historical political economy and political violence, with a region focus in Malaysia and Indonesia. I focus on how historical legacy shapes contemporary violence, inter-group relation and other governance outcome. 

Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a B.A. and M.A. in political science from National Taiwan University (NTU) in 2024 and 2022.
